remarks: Discover exceptional design and thoughtful craftsmanship in this *custom-built home by Art Homes*. A stunning open-to-above design, elegant railing, and soaring ceilings create an impressive sense of space, complemented by large windows that fill the home with natural light.  The main floor features a bedroom and full bathroom, ideal for guests or extended family, along with a walk-in pantry and a beautifully designed kitchen. Upstairs, enjoy **9-foot ceilings**, two additional bedrooms, a spacious bonus room, and a private primary retreat complete with an ensuite and walk-in closet. A conveniently located upper-floor laundry room adds everyday functionality.  With a separate side entrance offering added flexibility and a backyard with **no rear neighbours backing onto a walking trail**, this home combines custom design, comfort, and privacy in one exceptional package.
